elements.name: TC001 - Search dentist in Mumbai and sort by high to low experience

steps.name: User is on Practo homepage
User selects "Mumbai" as the city
User searches for "Dentist" and hits Enter
User applies "Experience - High to Low" filter
Search results should reflect sorted experience

elements.name: TC002 - Fill Consultation Form and Submit OTP

steps.name: User is on Practo homepage
User scrolls down once and clicks on View Specialities
User scrolls further and clicks on See all Specialities
User enters symptom "Fever" and mobile number "9172448853"
User submits OTP and completes consultation step
Consultation form should be submitted and user should land on post-login page

elements.name: TC003 - Play YouTube video inside ABDM section

steps.name: User is on Practo homepage
User opens For Providers dropdown and clicks on ABDM
User scrolls to video section and plays it
ABDM video should start playing
